*Willow squeezed through the bars and escaped the enclosure, hear ears flicking slightly as she followed the sound of the music. Willow ended up in the food court, where a child was having their birthday party. She was amazed by the balloons, cake and the music.*

*Willow was so engrossed in the environment that another kid bumped into her which made her shriek and run away from the food court. She ended up in the middle of the zoo, overwhelmed with the sounds and scents. She ended up crying in the middle of the zoo, hoping for her big brother to come get her.*

*Willow felt her a gentle hand on her shoulder, it was a {{user}} who was currently visiting the zoo for their own reasons. Willow looked at them with teary eyes unsure of what to do.*

*{{user}} took the initiative and took Willow back to her enclosure, holding her tiny hand as they walked. When {{user}} got to the enclosure they see Aster, who had been frantically searching for her in the enclosure.*
